title: Triage workflow used git diff to detect generated outputs, so first untracked report/triage files were not committed
symptom: The first Triage UIGS Pending run completed successfully and generated output in the runner workspace, but reports/red-reason-status.md did not appear in the repository.
root_cause: The workflow used git diff --quiet on output paths. git diff does not report untracked files, so a newly generated report or first triage JSON could be treated as 'no changes'.
resolution: Use git status --porcelain on the output paths when deciding whether generated files exist or changed.
Track an initial deterministic red-reason status report.
Remove volatile wall-clock generation time from the report so unchanged state does not create needless commits.
regression_guard: Triage workflow change detector includes untracked files.
Generated report content is deterministic for unchanged triage state.
Validate Foundry continues to unit-test triage logic.
reusable_lesson: A CI commit guard that must notice newly generated files cannot rely on git diff alone; it must include untracked working-tree state.

provenance.evidence_level: repository state after successful triage run; generated report absent
